mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 3.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal tightening policy combined with economic weakness, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (20-day returns positive >50% of periods).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime, rising new housing starts and strong consumer spending support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved economic outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals economic weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing contraction and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation erodes real corporate profits and increases the risk of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 290.0.
